# vendor/ — Third-party software and class files

## What belongs here

- Installation notes for licence-restricted software: `README_ORCA.md`, `README_MULTIWFN.md`, `README_EDA.md`.
- Vendored JINST class/style files if Route 2 of the Phase 8 acquisition succeeded, under `vendor/jinst/`.

## What must never go here

- The ORCA distribution itself. ORCA is free for academic use but requires individual registration and may not be redistributed.
- Any binary that cannot be re-obtained from a documented URL.
